newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares closed mostly lower on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares closed mostly lower on Thursday.

text.p: Italian shares closed mostly lower on Thursday as investors took profits after the sustained gains of recent days in which record highs have been successively breached.

The all-share Mibtel index finished 1.04 percent down at 15,005 and the blue chip Mib30 ended 1.16 percent lower at 22,831. The Fib30 stock index futures September contract dropped 1.25 percent to 23,150.

Earlier the Bundesbank kept its monetary policy on hold by leaving the growth target for M3 money supply and all leading interest rates unchanged but kept markets guessing where its main market rate would be set in two weeks' time.
The bourse also seized on Wall Street's easier trend to bring the market to an abrupt halt after three successive days of record-breaking rises.
Selected banks and some insurers were among the few stocks not to be cut down. Ambroveneto was 1.15 percent higher at 8,547 lire and Banca di Roma gained 2.9 percent to 1,528 lire.
Industrials were all marked down, led by Fiat, Olivetti, Pirelli and Montedison.
Edison was sharply lower, easing 5.81 percent percent to 8,660 lire on a decision by Enel to cut electricity purchases from private suppliers.
